cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Count What I Did
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you call that a quick shop, I carried twelve bags up six flights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know. Sit down; I'll put everything away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Thank you. The frozen peas came up separately. That was a second trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you sit down twice. I'll make tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tell everyone why I'm getting two rests? Otherwise it looks like one long sit.

mechanism: A corrects how B accounts for a grocery errand so the physical trips and effort are explicitly recognised, treating credit as something only A can measure correctly.
confusable: Generic praise seeking wants admiration; D33 demands acknowledgement of actual work and inconvenience rather than an unrelated compliment.
comparison: Fence alternative corrects a work estimate and referral; groceries alternative distinguishes rest offered from credit for separate trips.
seedUse: Twelve bags, six flights and second peas trip derive from D33-a; S03 adds precise correction of counts and acknowledgment wording.
